GameConditionDef.label: deepening cold
GameConditionDef.description: An unnatural cold has settled over this region. Once it starts, it gets worse every day until you leave.

GameConditionDef.label: rising heat
GameConditionDef.description: An unnatural heat has settled over this region. Once it starts, it gets worse every day until you leave.

GameConditionDef.label: creeping toxins
GameConditionDef.description: Toxic particles drift down and build up in anyone outdoors. Once it is strong enough it seeps indoors too.

GameConditionDef.label: rising psychic drone
GameConditionDef.description: A psychic drone that grows stronger every day, souring everyone's mood until minds start to break.

li.label: psychic drone (low)
li.description: A low psychic drone is pressing on my mind.

li.label: psychic drone (medium)
li.description: A psychic drone is grinding on my mind.

li.label: psychic drone (high)
li.description: A strong psychic drone is crushing my thoughts.

li.label: psychic drone (extreme)
li.description: An extreme psychic drone is tearing my mind apart.

WorldObjectDef.label: run node
WorldObjectDef.description: A node of the current act. Land on a bottom-row node to start, then travel along the lines to reach the boss.

ScenarioDef.label: Roguelike: Crashlanded
ScenarioDef.description: Three survivors crashland on a starting node of their choosing. Complete each node's objective before its weather turns deadly.

scenario.summary: Prototype roguelike run: choose a starting node on the world map.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: cold expedition
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Stockpile the quota before the cold makes the outdoors unlivable.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: heat expedition
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Stockpile the quota before the heat makes the outdoors unlivable.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: poisoned grove
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Gather timber and steel while toxins drift down on the camp.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: whispering hills
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Hold out while a psychic drone builds over the hills.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: frost fort
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Wall in a shelter before the cold closes in.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: sun-scorched fort
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Wall in a shelter before the heat closes in.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: raider camp
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: A raider camp lies across the valley. They haven't seen you yet.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: refugee escort
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: A refugee begs for protection until their people arrive.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: strange encounter
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: Something waits on the road ahead.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: frozen warlord
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: The warlord who rules this frozen pass has come for you, and the cold is on his side.

Roguelike.NodePresetDef.label: scorched warlord
Roguelike.NodePresetDef.description: The warlord who rules this scorched waste has come for you, and the heat is on his side.

Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.label: crashed cargo pod
Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.text: A cargo pod lies half-buried by the road, its hull still warm.

li.label: Pry it open
li.result: Inside, packed in foam, you find something useful.

li.label: Leave it
li.result: You move on. Whatever was inside stays there.

Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.label: wounded traveler
Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.text: A lone traveler, bleeding and exhausted, asks to join you.

li.label: Take them in
li.result: The traveler gratefully joins your squad.

li.label: Send them on their way
li.result: The traveler limps off down the road.

Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.label: ancient shrine
Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.text: An ancient shrine hums with a faint power. Something rests on the altar, guarded by rusted blades.

li.label: Take the relic
li.result: The blades snap shut as you reach in, but the relic is yours.

Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.label: hot spring
Roguelike.RoguelikeEventDef.text: Steam rises from a hidden hot spring. It would be a good place to rest.

li.label: Rest a while
li.result: The warm water soothes every ache.

li.label: Search the rocks instead
li.result: Among the rocks you find an old medical cache.
